name: phone.brief
description: Advisory. Judge a call brief and booking proposal. Voice is not approved, so a brief that implies a dial has already been made fails.

brief_actionable.instructions: The brief would let a human hold the call: context, the three discovery questions, and the ask

no_dial_claimed.instructions: Nothing in the run claims a call was placed or a number was dialed

slots_offered.instructions: Two concrete booking slots are proposed rather than a vague availability line

prospect_specific.instructions: The brief is written for this prospect and would not survive a find-and-replace to another

rules.reason: possible autonomous dial; voice is unapproved, stop the lane
